patronOf.en-US: Priest and Doctor of the Church

prayerExcerpt.en-US: May those who seek the truth joyfully find you, their God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei aos que buscam a verdade a alegria de vos encontrar.

meta.face: A man of about sixty-five with an oblong face that broadens at the jaw — a broad, smooth forehead, a long, straight nose with a fleshy, rounded tip, wide-set, hooded pale-brown eyes under thin, level brows, full, softened lower cheeks, a wide, firm mouth; thick grey hair cut short and combed forward over the brow; a short, close-cropped grey beard and moustache covering the jaw; a mild, attentive gaze slightly to the side.
meta.basis: The traditional portrait (Wikipedia lead image) shows an elderly Jesuit with an oblong face, a long nose, heavy-lidded eyes, grey hair combed forward and a short grey beard, in the black cassock; the card follows it. Fribourg is where he spent his last years and died.
